items.title: 一場IPO喊卡牽動記憶體市場！美光Sandisk受惠、英特爾失潛在大單
items.title_en: An IPO Halt Sends Ripples Through the Memory Market! Micron and SanDisk Benefit, Intel Misses Potential Deal
paras: SK海力士(000660KS) (SKHY-US) 放棄旗下Solidigm赴美首次公開發行（IPO）計畫，讓全球NAND快閃記憶體市場少了一個潛在產能擴張來源。LYNX Equity Strategies分析師認為，此舉降低中長期供應增加、壓抑價格的風險，對美光(MU-US) 與SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 均屬實質利多，但當前市場環境仍可能限制兩家公司股價漲幅。
根據LYNX周五(23日)發布的研究報告，Solidigm若順利完成IPO，募集資金將用於在美國擴建NAND產能，可能在三年或更長時間後推升全球供應量，進而對產業定價構成壓力。
IPO告吹 未來擴產壓力減輕
隨著上市計畫取消，這項擴產融資管道關閉，相關供應增加風險也隨之降低。LYNX指出，Solidigm赴美IPO告吹，消除了全球NAND市場一個潛在的新增產能壓力來源。
由KC Rajkumar領軍的分析師團隊強調，這項計畫原本帶來的並非即時供應增量，而是三年乃至更長時間後可能釋出的產能。因此，取消IPO的影響主要落在中長期供應前景，並未立即改變目前NAND市場的供應格局。
美國新廠原擬落腳英特爾園區
Solidigm規劃中的美國生產基地，原本預計由SK海力士與英特爾(INTC-US) 共同出資，可能選址於英特爾位在俄亥俄州的園區。這座美國本土製造基地一旦建成，將具備快速擴充產能的條件。
在LYNX的分析中，IPO募資與美國擴產計畫相互關聯。上市取得資金後，新增產能可能在數年後進入市場，成為影響全球NAND供需與價格的因素；如今融資管道關閉，這項中長期供應壓力的來源也跟著減少。
因此，分析師看待這項變化的重點，在於未來潛在產能擴張風險降低，而非現有產能退出市場或供應立即縮減。
美光、Sandisk定價與估值獲支撐
LYNX明確指出，Solidigm上市計畫告吹，對美光與Sandisk「均屬實質利多」。兩家公司同為NAND供應商，未來產能成長風險下降，有助於支撐產業定價與估值水準。
NAND市場對供需變化敏感，產能規劃的變動可能影響價格走勢。少了Solidigm美國新產能這個潛在競爭來源，美光與Sandisk未來面對的供應擴張壓力可望減輕，定價空間也因此獲得一定支撐。
不過，這項利多主要反映未來競爭來源減少，尚不能直接等同於當前供需已經改善。兩家公司能否將供應面的有利變化轉化為實際業績成長，仍須觀察產業整體產能規劃，以及後續供需關係的演變。
英特爾失去潛在製造案
相較於美光與Sandisk可能受惠，LYNX認為，Solidigm計畫擱置對英特爾構成小幅利空，原因在於其俄亥俄州園區失去一個潛在製造項目，園區利用規劃也因此受到一定影響。
分析師同時提醒，供應面風險降低雖有利於NAND供應商，但當前市場環境可能限制美光與Sandisk股價的實際漲幅。週五美光收漲2.46%，Sandisk則收跌1.82%，兩家公司股價表現分歧。
LYNX的判斷核心，是Solidigm取消IPO減少了未來新增供應的可能性，為既有NAND供應商帶來中長期支撐；至於利多能否進一步反映在業績與股價上，仍取決於產業後續發展。
paras_en: SK Hynix (000660KS) (SKHY-US) has abandoned its Solidigm subsidiary's plan to go public in the United States, removing a potential source of capacity expansion from the global NAND flash memory market. LYNX Equity Strategies analysts say the move lowers the medium‑to‑long‑term risk of supply increases that could suppress prices, which is a material upside for Micron (MU-US) and SanDisk (SNDKV-US), although the current market environment may still limit the two stocks' gains.

According to LYNX’s research report released on Friday the 23rd, if Solidigm had successfully completed the IPO, the proceeds would have been used to expand NAND capacity in the United States, potentially boosting global supply three years or more down the line and putting downward pressure on industry pricing.
IPO Called Off, Future Expansion Pressure Eases

With the cancellation of the listing plan, the financing channel for the expansion is closed, and the risk of a supply increase also diminishes. LYNX notes that the collapse of Solidigm’s U.S. IPO removes a potential new capacity pressure source from the global NAND market.

The analyst team led by KC Rajkumar stresses that the plan was never about an immediate supply boost but about capacity that might be released three years or more in the future. Therefore, the impact of the IPO cancellation is mainly on the medium‑to‑long‑term supply outlook and does not instantly change the current NAND supply landscape.
New U.S. Plant Was Originally Planned for Intel Campus

The U.S. production base that Solidigm had planned was to be jointly funded by SK Hynix and Intel (INTC-US) and was likely to be located at Intel’s campus in Ohio. Once built, this domestic manufacturing site would have the ability to scale capacity quickly.

In LYNX’s analysis, the IPO proceeds and the U.S. expansion plan were interlinked. After raising capital through the listing, the new capacity could have entered the market in a few years, influencing global NAND supply‑demand balance and pricing; now that the financing route is closed, that medium‑to‑long‑term supply pressure source is also reduced.
Thus, analysts view the change as a reduction in future potential capacity‑expansion risk rather than a withdrawal of existing capacity or an immediate supply contraction.
Micron and SanDisk Pricing and Valuation Supported

LYNX explicitly states that the collapse of Solidigm’s listing plan is a “material upside” for both Micron and SanDisk. As NAND suppliers, the two firms face lower future capacity‑growth risk, which helps support industry pricing and valuation levels.

The NAND market is sensitive to supply‑demand shifts, and changes in capacity planning can affect price trends. With the potential U.S. new capacity from Solidigm removed, the expansion pressure Micron and SanDisk may face in the future is expected to ease, giving their pricing power some support.

However, this upside mainly reflects a reduction in future competitive sources and cannot be taken as a sign that current supply‑demand conditions have improved. Whether the two companies can turn the favorable supply‑side shift into actual earnings growth will depend on overall industry capacity planning and the subsequent evolution of supply‑demand dynamics.
Intel Loses Potential Manufacturing Project

Compared with the possible benefits to Micron and SanDisk, LYNX believes that shelving the Solidigm plan is a modest downside for Intel, as its Ohio campus loses a potential manufacturing project, affecting the campus’s utilization planning.

Analysts also caution that while lower supply‑side risk benefits NAND suppliers, the present market environment may limit the actual stock price gains for Micron and SanDisk. On Friday Micron closed up 2.46% while SanDisk fell 1.82%, showing divergent performance.

LYNX’s core judgment is that canceling Solidigm’s IPO reduces the likelihood of future new supply, providing medium‑to‑long‑term support for existing NAND suppliers; whether this upside translates into earnings and stock price improvements will depend on how the industry develops thereafter.

items.title: 蘋果摺疊機iPhone Duo螢幕「超脆弱」？有人用不到6小時、折不到20次就破裂
items.title_en: Apple Foldable iPhone Duo Screen "Ultra Fragile"? Some Users Report Cracks After Less Than 6 Hours and Fewer Than 20 Folds
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊螢幕手機 iPhone Duo 上市後，陸續傳出內螢幕破裂的案例。從中國、美國到澳洲、加拿大，均有用戶反映類似問題，受損位置多集中在機身中央的摺疊區域。部分用戶表示，新機使用不到一天就出現裂痕，甚至有人在展開不到 20 次後，便發現螢幕沿著折痕破裂，引發外界對產品耐用性的疑慮。
根據《Tom"s Guide》與《PhoneArena》報導，社群平台 Reddit 陸續出現 iPhone Duo 螢幕損壞的照片。
一名澳洲用戶表示，購入新機約 6 小時後，在一次正常展開手機的過程中聽見異常聲響，隨後發現內螢幕沿中央折痕裂開。該用戶稱，事發前手機沒有明顯受到撞擊，最後透過蘋果零售門市更換新機。
其他用戶也回報類似情況，包括使用不到一天便發現裂痕，以及尚未完成初始設定，螢幕就已出現顯示異常的案例。
除了實際使用者的損壞回報，耐用度測試也讓外界開始關注 iPhone Duo 的結構設計。
儘管 iPhone Duo 標示具備 IP68 防塵防水等級，相關測試仍發現，灰塵可能從多個入口進入鉸鏈機構。由於鉸鏈是摺疊手機反覆開合的關鍵結構，灰塵侵入也引發外界對長期使用可靠性的疑問。
在後續的破壞性彎折測試中，手機內螢幕出現無法消除的綠色亮線，最終觸控功能也失效，受損區域同樣集中在中央摺疊處。
然而，極端條件下的破壞性測試不等同於一般使用情境，現有結果也無法證實灰塵侵入與螢幕破裂之間存在直接因果關係。
螢幕材質的差異，也是這次爭議的另一個焦點。
測試顯示，採用 Ceramic Shield 2 的外螢幕具備較好的抗刮能力，但柔性內螢幕相對脆弱，在莫氏硬度 2 級的測試下便出現刮痕，甚至可能被指甲刮傷。這類限制也存在於柔性螢幕產品，並非蘋果獨有。
不過，iPhone Duo 售價接近 2,000 美元，消費者對產品品質與耐用性的期待自然不低。相較之下，三星、華為及小米等廠商已累積多代摺疊手機的開發經驗，蘋果作為較晚進入市場的業者，首款產品也因此面臨更高的檢驗標準。
隨著螢幕破裂案例在網路上流傳，部分已預訂手機的消費者開始考慮取消訂單或延後購買，售後服務也受到關注。
前述澳洲用戶雖然最終在蘋果門市換得新機，但透過電話申請快速換機時，仍遇到整機金額預先授權，以及無法確定新機到貨時間等問題。
對於故障原因，《PhoneArena》認為，多起相似的損壞案例可能指向鉸鏈設計問題；《Gadget Review》則指出，目前尚無經確認的整體故障率數據，也沒有證據證明 iPhone Duo 的損壞率高於其他摺疊螢幕手機。
對蘋果而言，除了摺疊螢幕帶來的輕薄設計與大尺寸顯示體驗，如何確保手機能夠承受日常反覆開合，並提供穩定可靠的使用品質，將是這款高價新機能否獲得消費者信任的關鍵。
paras_en: After the launch of Apple’s (AAPL-US) first fold‑screen phone, the iPhone Duo, reports of internal screen breakage have begun to surface. Users from China, the United States, Australia and Canada have all reported similar issues, with damage most often occurring in the central folding area of the chassis. Some users say the new device developed cracks in less than a day, and a few discovered the screen fractured along the crease after fewer than 20 openings, raising doubts about the product’s durability.
According to reports from Tom’s Guide and PhoneArena, photos of iPhone Duo screen damage have been appearing on the Reddit community platform.

An Australian user said that about six hours after purchasing the new phone, a strange sound was heard while opening the device normally, and the internal screen split along the central crease. The user claimed the phone had not suffered any obvious impact beforehand and ultimately obtained a replacement unit through an Apple retail store.
Other users have reported similar situations, including discovering cracks in under a day and experiencing display anomalies before even completing the initial setup.
In addition to the real‑world damage reports, durability testing has drawn attention to the iPhone Duo’s structural design.

Although the iPhone Duo is marketed with an IP68 dust‑and‑water resistance rating, tests have found that dust can enter the hinge mechanism through multiple entry points. Because the hinge is the critical component that endures repeated opening and closing of a foldable phone, dust ingress has sparked concerns about long‑term reliability.
In subsequent destructive bend tests, the internal screen showed an irrecoverable green line and eventually lost touch functionality, with the damaged area again concentrated at the central fold.
However, destructive testing under extreme conditions does not equate to normal usage scenarios, and the current results cannot confirm a direct causal link between dust ingress and screen breakage.
The difference in screen materials is another focal point of the controversy.

Tests show that the outer screen, which uses Ceramic Shield 2, offers better scratch resistance, while the flexible inner screen is relatively fragile; it shows scratches under a Mohs hardness of 2 and can even be scratched by a fingernail. These limitations are common to flexible‑screen products and are not unique to Apple.

Nevertheless, the iPhone Duo is priced near $2,000, so consumer expectations for quality and durability are naturally high. By comparison, Samsung, Huawei and Xiaomi have accumulated several generations of foldable‑phone development experience, and Apple, as a later market entrant, faces a higher bar of scrutiny for its first product.
As screen‑breakage stories spread online, some consumers who have already placed orders are considering canceling or postponing their purchases, and after‑sales service is drawing attention.

The Australian user mentioned earlier eventually received a replacement at an Apple store, but when requesting a rapid exchange by phone, they encountered a pre‑authorization of the full device price and uncertainty about the arrival time of the new unit.

Regarding the cause of the failures, PhoneArena suggests that multiple similar damage cases may point to a hinge‑design issue, while Gadget Review notes that there is currently no verified overall failure‑rate data and no evidence that the iPhone Duo’s failure rate exceeds that of other foldable‑screen phones.

For Apple, beyond the thin‑and‑light design and large‑display experience that a foldable screen provides, ensuring the phone can withstand daily repeated opening and closing while delivering stable, reliable performance will be key to whether this high‑priced new device can earn consumer trust.

items.title: 法國爆發大規模示威 41萬人再上街 近千人被捕
items.title_en: France erupts with massive protests, 410,000 take to the streets, nearly a thousand arrested
paras: 法國連續第二個周末爆發大規模示威，約41萬人24日（周六）走上街頭，抗議生活成本上漲、社會不平等及政府經濟政策。
據《路透社》、《CNN》等媒體24日報導，法國內政部統計，當天全國約41萬人參加抗議，其中巴黎約11萬人。法國總工會（CGT）則估計全國參與人數接近80萬人。
當天，法國多個城市舉行示威活動。巴黎遊行最初總體平穩，但在活動結束後，部分蒙面人員與警方起衝突。約500名蒙面人員向警察投擲石塊等物品，防暴警察隨後使用催淚瓦斯和高壓水炮驅散人群。
法國第二大城市馬賽，部分人員使用大型金屬板封堵道路，焚燒垃圾桶，向警察投擲石塊和瓶子。警方表示，多家商鋪遭到洗劫。里昂、波爾多等城市也發生不同程度衝突。
法國內政部長洛朗·努涅斯24日晚表示，當天全國近1,000人被捕。他說大部分遊行活動總體平穩，但部分警察遭遇嚴重暴力行為。與17日相比，當天暴力事件減少。
巴黎香榭麗舍大街上部分品牌門市張貼了停業通知，旺多姆廣場附近多家奢侈品商店也選擇關閉，部分大型奢侈品牌則加強安保。
「幾乎沒有顧客，所以開店不太值得。」巴黎一家Kiton精品店經理奧斯卡說。
抗議活動也影響了巴黎旅遊業。
據《路透社》24日報導，盧浮宮、奧賽博物館、橘園美術館、畢加索博物館等多家文化場所當天關閉，杜樂麗花園也被封鎖。巴黎歌劇院關閉了加尼葉宮和巴士底歌劇院，巴黎巴塞爾藝術展取消了周末活動安排。
在盧浮宮外，不少遊客發現大門緊鎖，不僅無法參觀《蒙娜麗莎》，甚至連博物館標誌性玻璃金字塔也無法靠近。
一名來自加拿大的遊客表示，巴黎街頭已經部署了這麼多警察，博物館關閉似乎有些反應過度。
法國左翼政黨「不屈法國」領導人讓-呂克·梅朗雄當天參加了巴黎示威，並警告總統馬克宏，如果政府繼續無視抗議者的訴求，法國可能面臨更大規模罷工行動。
據《CNN》報導，梅朗雄24日表示，法國總工會計劃11月5日發起全國性大罷工。他警告，除非馬克宏「現在讓步」，否則政府將面臨「更加危險的局面」。
paras_en: France experienced a second consecutive weekend of massive protests, with about 410,000 people taking to the streets on Saturday, the 24th, to protest rising living costs, social inequality and government economic policies.

According to Reuters, CNN and other media on the 24th, the French Interior Ministry counted roughly 410,000 participants nationwide that day, including about 110,000 in Paris. The General Confederation of Labour (CGT) estimated the total number of participants across the country at close to 800,000.

That day, demonstrations were held in multiple French cities. The Paris march was initially overall peaceful, but after the event ended, some masked individuals clashed with police. Around 500 masked people threw stones and other objects at officers, prompting riot police to deploy tear gas and high‑pressure water cannons to disperse the crowd.

In Marseille, France’s second‑largest city, some protesters used large metal plates to block roads, set trash bins on fire and hurled stones and bottles at police. Police said several shops were looted. Lyon, Bordeaux and other cities also saw varying levels of conflict.

Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said on the evening of the 24th that nearly 1,000 people were arrested nationwide that day. He noted that most of the marches were overall peaceful, but some police officers faced serious violence. He added that violent incidents were fewer than on the 17th.

Several brand stores on Paris’s Champs‑Élysées posted notices of closure, and many luxury shops near Place Vendôme also chose to shut their doors, while some major luxury brands stepped up security measures.
“There are almost no customers, so it’s not really worth opening,” said Oscar, the manager of a Kiton boutique in Paris.
The protests also impacted Paris’s tourism sector.

Reuters reported on the 24th that the Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, Musée de l’Orangerie, Picasso Museum and several other cultural venues were closed that day, and the Tuileries Garden was blocked. The Paris Opera shut down the Garnier and Bastille theatres, and the Paris Basel Art Fair cancelled its weekend programme.
Outside the Louvre, many visitors found the gates locked, preventing access not only to the Mona Lisa but even to the museum’s iconic glass pyramid.
A Canadian visitor remarked that so many police were deployed on the streets of Paris that the museum closures seemed a bit excessive.

Jean‑Luc Mélenchon, leader of the left‑wing party La France Insoumise, joined the Paris demonstration that day and warned President Emmanuel Macron that if the government continues to ignore protesters’ demands, France could face an even larger strike action.

According to CNN, Mélenchon said on the 24th that the CGT plans to launch a nationwide general strike on November 5. He warned that unless Macron “concedes now,” the government will face “an even more dangerous situation.”

items.title: 反恐部隊上街、羅浮宮關門！法國爆發新一波抗議浪潮、動盪有蔓延歐洲之勢
items.title_en: Anti-Terror Units on the Streets, Louvre Closed! France Faces a New Wave of Protests, Turmoil Threatening to Spread Across Europe
paras: 法國再度面臨全國性抗議活動，暴力騷亂不僅迫使政府大規模部署安保人員，也加深市場對法國財政狀況與經濟前景的疑慮。隨著巴黎商業活動及觀光景點受到衝擊，法德公債利差升至歐元區債務危機以來高點，最新民間企業活動數據也顯示經濟陷入萎縮。
根據外媒報導，為防範被稱為「第二幕」（Acte II）的新一輪抗議，法國政府全面升級維安部署。
法國內政部長Laurent Nunez週五表示，政府將動員7萬名安保人員，其中包括精銳反恐部隊。軍方也將協助守護敏感建築，直升機、水砲車及名為Centaurs的裝甲車均已待命。包括里昂在內的部分城市，則已宣布週六禁止抗議活動並延長宵禁。
Nunez將社群媒體上的暴力號召歸咎於極左翼勢力，並強調政府不會容忍暴徒、搶劫者及任何實施暴力的團體。
法國總統馬克宏（Emmanuel Macron）承認，上週末暴力事件的應對過程存在疏失，並延後原定外交行程，將重心轉向國內危機，他並將煽動行為歸咎於極左翼團體。
距離第二任期結束約剩半年，馬克宏正處於支持率低谷。這波抗議最初源自民眾要求改善公共服務，以及政府應介入處理高昂生活成本等訴求。
Cluster 17為《L’Opinion》進行的民調顯示，抗議運動目前仍獲得53%受訪者支持，但支持率較前次調查下降4個百分點。另一方面，希望抗議儘速結束的受訪者占59%，增加6個百分點。
民調也顯示，暴力事件可能使明年總統大選的領跑者、極右翼政治人物勒朋（Marine Le Pen）受益。
勒朋預計週六在奧爾良為其所屬的國民聯盟舉行黨代表大會，吸引數千名支持者出席；與此同時，包括左翼人士及工會領袖在內的數千名反對者，也已在當地市中心發起遊行。
法國持續動盪的局勢正對金融市場構成壓力。法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差週四（22日）升至178個基點，遠高於9月初的85個基點，創歐元區債務危機以來新高，反映投資人對法國財政風險的擔憂升高。
儘管法國週五（23日）晚間暫時躲過穆迪（Moody’s Ratings）調降信用評等，但在2027年大選前，政府削減預算赤字的努力仍面臨挑戰。
經濟數據同樣不樂觀。標普全球（S&P Global）編製的法國綜合採購經理人指數（PMI）10月降至48.4，低於上月的51.1，也跌破代表景氣擴張與萎縮分界的50，顯示民間企業活動轉弱。
抗議引發的暴力風險已迫使巴黎部分商家加強防護，奢侈品店封住櫥窗、增派保全，部分門市則暫停營業。
觀光景點也受到波及，羅浮宮、奧賽博物館及畢卡索博物館週六（24日）均閉館，原定在巴黎舉行的巴黎聖日耳曼對里昂足球賽也遭到延期。
瑞士鐘錶品牌百年靈（Breitling）執行長警告，遊客減少可能衝擊即將到來的假日購物旺季，為零售業帶來額外壓力。
巴黎市長Emmanuel Grégoire則表示，市政府正為動盪持續數週的情況做準備，相關損失可能高達數千萬歐元。他也在社群媒體指出，有跡象顯示暴力示威者計劃於本週六及下週六前往首都集結。
法國的社會動盪之外，歐洲其他國家也面臨示威升溫的風險。
義大利米蘭及羅馬預計週末將出現學生與青年示威。此前當地上週末發生搶劫與騷亂，義大利政府已表示將在米蘭部署軍隊。
比利時預計也將爆發抗議活動；阿爾巴尼亞則持續應對因不滿總理Edi Rama執政而引發、進入第二週的暴力示威。
paras_en: France is once again facing nationwide protests, with violent riots forcing the government to deploy security personnel on a large scale and deepening market doubts about France's fiscal situation and economic outlook. As commercial activity in Paris and tourist attractions are hit, the France‑Germany bond yield spread has risen to its highest level since the euro‑area debt crisis, and the latest private‑sector activity data also show the economy contracting.
According to foreign media reports, to guard against a new round of protests dubbed “Acte II” (Second Act), the French government has fully upgraded its security deployment.

Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said on Friday that the government will mobilise 70,000 security personnel, including elite anti‑terror units. The military will also help protect sensitive buildings, with helicopters, water‑cannon trucks and armored vehicles called Centaurs on standby. Some cities, including Lyon, have announced a ban on protests on Saturday and an extension of the curfew.
Nunez blamed the violent calls on social media on far‑left forces and stressed that the government will not tolerate rioters, looters or any groups that use violence.

President Emmanuel Macron admitted that the response to last weekend’s violent incidents was flawed, postponed his planned diplomatic trips and shifted focus to the domestic crisis, blaming the incitement on far‑left groups.

With about six months left in his second term, Macron is at a low point in approval ratings. The protests originally stemmed from public demands for better services and for the government to address soaring living costs.

A poll by L’Opinion’s Cluster 17 shows the protest movement still enjoys support from 53 % of respondents, down four percentage points from the previous survey, while 59 % want the protests to end quickly, up six points.
The poll also indicates that the violence could benefit far‑right candidate Marine Le Pen, who is the frontrunner for next year’s presidential election.

Le Pen is expected to hold a party congress for her National Rally in Orléans on Saturday, drawing thousands of supporters; at the same time, thousands of opponents, including left‑wing activists and union leaders, have launched a march in the city centre.

France’s ongoing turmoil is putting pressure on financial markets. The spread between French and German 10‑year bond yields rose on Thursday (the 22nd) to 178 basis points, far above the 85‑basis‑point level in early September and a new high since the euro‑area debt crisis, reflecting heightened investor concerns over French fiscal risk.
Although France temporarily avoided a Moody’s credit‑rating downgrade on Friday night (the 23rd), the government’s efforts to cut the budget deficit remain challenged ahead of the 2027 election.

Economic data remain bleak. S&P Global’s composite Purchasing Managers’ Index for France fell to 48.4 in October, down from 51.1 the month before and below the 50‑point threshold that separates expansion from contraction, indicating weakening private‑sector activity.
The risk of violence from the protests has forced some Paris merchants to beef up security, with luxury stores boarding up windows and adding guards, and some outlets suspending operations.

Tourist sites have also been hit: the Louvre, the Musée d’Orsay and the Picasso Museum will all be closed on Saturday (the 24th), and the Paris Saint‑Germain versus Lyon football match scheduled in Paris has been postponed.
Breitling CEO warned that a drop in visitors could hit the upcoming holiday shopping season, adding extra pressure on the retail sector.

Paris Mayor Emmanuel Grégoire said the city is preparing for weeks‑long unrest, with potential losses running into tens of millions of euros. He also noted on social media that there are signs protestors plan to gather in the capital this Saturday and the following Saturday.
Beyond France’s social unrest, other European countries also face a heightened risk of demonstrations.
Student and youth protests are expected in Milan and Rome this weekend. After robberies and riots last weekend, the Italian government has said it will deploy troops in Milan.
Belgium is also expected to see protests; Albania continues to deal with a second‑week wave of violent demonstrations sparked by dissatisfaction with Prime Minister Edi Rama’s government.

items.title: 美期中選舉前大盤加速趕底 8檔台股搶手型ETF戰力猛
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Election Looms as Taiwan Market Accelerates Bottom‑Finding; Six Semiconductor‑Focused ETFs Among the Hottest Picks
paras: 10 月來外資連續賣超台股，大盤跌得鼻青臉腫，不過，台股ETF中，仍有不少檔績效搶眼，規模成長異軍突起，根據CMoney統計，截至2026/10/22為止，近1年大盤上漲約66.5%，績效表現最好的台股ETF中，出現6檔半導體型、1檔科技型、1檔主動型脫穎而出，不論規模、績效都維持正成長。法人表示，美國期中選舉前，台股行情轉趨震盪，大盤加速趕底過程中，只要績效持續衝高、規模不斷增加，都表示這類ETF獲投資人青睞，是台股搶手型ETF。
根據CMoney統計至10/22止，近1年台股主、被動ETF績效最好的前十強名單中，計有8檔ETF不論績效、規模都雙雙正成長，帶動ETF出現績效好、買氣旺的搶手表現，績效方面，台新臺灣IC設計(00947-TW)上漲122.31%，表現最好，而兆豐台灣晶圓製造(00913-TW)、野村臺灣新科技50(00935-TW)分別上漲120.25%、108.55%，緊追在後。
至於主動式台股ETF，則有主動統一台股增長ETF(00981A-TW)唯一進榜；排名第5到10名，全數由半導體ETF擔綱，依序為中信00891、富邦00892、台新00904、群益00927等，財富管理專家分析，今年半導體類股表現強勢，不少重量級個股從年初迄今一路表現強勢，是台股多頭的領頭羊，帶動半導體ETF績效也跟著水漲船高。
規模方面，唯一進榜的主動統一台股增長ETF(00981A-TW)，近1年規模成長1,231.56%，增幅強壓其他台股被動ETF，表現亦一枝獨秀；而其他半導體ETF如群益00927、台新00947、中信00891，台新00904四檔，規模也都有約1至5倍不等的增幅。

台新00904、00947兩檔ETF經理人黃鈺民表示，台積電10月法說，已再次確認全球半導體的晶片需求強勁，獲利能見度拉高，AI需求也將持續為半導體供應鏈帶來新訂單，從最新8月台灣外銷訂單首度突破千億美元，年增逾7成來看，台灣AI、半導體供應鏈接單能力強，在企業營運業績展望亮麗下，預估2027年台灣半導體企業憑藉先進製程技術、成熟供應鏈生態系及長期客戶夥伴深厚關係，競爭護城河仍保持完整，全球半導體供應鏈的核心地位短期內難以被取代。
他建議投資人趁現在台股盤勢不穩，可分批持有台灣半導體產業型ETF或聚焦AI擴散行情帶旺IC設計、記憶體為核心的IC設計產業ETF，掌握全球AI紅利引爆、行情擴散下的科技股新牛勢。

paras_en: In October, foreign investors have been net sellers of Taiwanese stocks, leaving the market bruised, yet several Taiwan‑stock ETFs have posted eye‑catching performance and rapid asset growth. According to CMoney data up to 2026‑10‑22, the broader market rose about 66.5% over the past year, and the best‑performing ETFs include six semiconductor‑focused, one technology‑focused and one active‑managed fund, all showing positive growth in both scale and returns. Analysts say that ahead of the U.S. midterm elections the Taiwan market is becoming more volatile, and as the index races toward a bottom, ETFs that keep delivering strong returns and expanding assets are clearly favored by investors, making them the most sought‑after Taiwan ETFs.

Based on CMoney’s ranking as of 10/22, eight of the top‑ten performing Taiwan ETFs—both active and passive—have seen simultaneous growth in returns and assets, driving a hot‑buyer market. In terms of performance, Taishin Taiwan IC Design (00947‑TW) led with a 122.31% gain, followed by Mega Financial Taiwan Wafer Manufacturing (00913‑TW) up 120.25% and Nomura Taiwan New Technology 50 (00935‑TW) up 108.55%.

Among active Taiwan ETFs, only the Active Uni‑Taiwan Growth ETF (00981A‑TW) made the list. Positions five through ten were all occupied by semiconductor ETFs: CTBC 00891, Fubon 00892, Taishin 00904 and Yuanta 00927, in that order. Wealth‑management experts note that semiconductor stocks have been strong this year, with many heavyweight names delivering robust performance since the start of the year, leading the market’s bullish trend and lifting semiconductor‑ETF returns along with it.

In terms of scale, the sole active entrant, Uni‑Taiwan Growth ETF (00981A‑TW), grew its assets by 1,231.56% over the past year, outpacing all other passive Taiwan ETFs and standing out uniquely. The other semiconductor ETFs—Yuanta 00927, Taishin 00947, CTBC 00891 and Taishin 00904—also posted asset increases ranging roughly from one‑ to five‑fold.

ETF managers Huang Yu‑min of Taishin 00904 and 00947 said TSMC’s October earnings call reaffirmed strong global chip demand and raised profit visibility, with AI driving new orders throughout the semiconductor supply chain. Taiwan’s August export orders broke the US$100 billion mark for the first time, up more than 70% year‑over‑year, underscoring the island’s AI and semiconductor order‑taking strength. Looking ahead to 2027, they expect Taiwanese semiconductor firms to maintain a solid competitive moat thanks to advanced process technology, a mature supply‑chain ecosystem and deep long‑term customer relationships, keeping Taiwan at the core of the global semiconductor supply chain in the near term.

He advises investors to take advantage of the current market volatility by gradually building positions in Taiwan semiconductor‑industry ETFs or ETFs focused on AI‑driven IC design and memory sectors, to capture the new tech‑stock rally sparked by global AI dividends and market diffusion.

items.title: 蘋果iPhone Duo門市取貨預約陸續恢復！預購需求爆發、部分市場仍無名額
items.title_en: Apple iPhone Duo In‑Store Pickup Reservations Gradually Resuming; Pre‑order Demand Soars, Some Markets Still Have No Slots
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 新款 iPhone Duo 開放預購後需求遠超預期。好消息是，Apple Store 門市取貨預約近期陸續恢復，但目前可預約名額仍相當有限，部分國家甚至幾乎沒有可選時段，消費者能否順利取貨仍取決於供貨情況。
根據《MacRumors》報導，蘋果線上商店已在澳洲、中國、日本及南韓等市場重新開放 iPhone Duo 的 Apple Store 門市取貨預約。
不過，該報實際查詢發現，多數機型幾乎沒有可預約時段。報導刊出前，澳洲一度僅查到一台 iPhone Duo 可供周六（24日）門市取貨，但該名額隨後已消失。
至於美國、加拿大、英國及新加坡等其他國家與地區，蘋果線上商店仍提示顧客於 10 月 24 日再次查看門市取貨選項。
報導指出，隨著各地陸續進入周六，預期取貨預約功能將逐步在更多市場恢復。
iPhone Duo 週五（23日）開放預購後僅數小時，蘋果便表示，這款裝置的需求「極為驚人」，預計出貨時間已延至 1 月下旬。
蘋果則表示，正努力「盡快滿足」市場需求。在供貨吃緊的情況下，門市取貨名額難以取得，也反映出消費者對新機的搶購熱度。
由於供貨稀少，今天全球多家 Apple Store 門市外都出現大排長龍的情況，部分幸運的顧客則成功在未預約的情況下，直接到店購得 iPhone Duo。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL‑US) opened pre‑orders for the new iPhone Duo and demand has far exceeded expectations. The good news is that Apple Store in‑store pickup reservations are slowly coming back, but the number of available slots remains very limited, and in some countries there are almost no time slots to choose from, so whether consumers can pick up their devices smoothly still depends on supply conditions.
According to MacRumors, Apple’s online store has reopened Apple Store in‑store pickup reservations for the iPhone Duo in markets such as Australia, China, Japan and South Korea.

However, the report’s own checks found that most models have virtually no reservable slots. Before the story was published, Australia at one point showed only one iPhone Duo available for Saturday (the 24th) store pickup, and that slot disappeared shortly thereafter.
For other countries and regions such as the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Singapore, Apple’s online store still advises customers to check the store‑pickup option again on October 24.
The article notes that as more regions move into Saturday, the pickup‑reservation feature is expected to gradually return in more markets.
Only a few hours after the iPhone Duo opened for pre‑order on Friday (the 23rd), Apple said the device’s demand was “extraordinary” and pushed the expected shipping date back to late January.
Apple said it is working to “meet market demand as quickly as possible.” Tight supply makes in‑store pickup slots hard to obtain and reflects the intense consumer rush for the new device.

Because of the scarce supply, long queues have formed outside many Apple Store locations worldwide today, and a few lucky customers managed to walk in without a reservation and walk out with an iPhone Duo.

items.title: 房子只買負擔得起的一半！《大賣空》貝瑞奉勸Z世代：避開沉重房貸、公開10條人生生存建言
items.title_en: Buy Only Half the House You Can Afford! Michael Burry of "The Big Short" Advises Gen Z to Dodge Heavy Mortgages and Shares 10 Life Survival Tips
paras: 《財星雜誌》(Fortune)報導，電影《大賣空》(The Big Short)原型貝瑞(Michael Burry)在自己的Substack電子報《Cassandra Unchained》透露，有人請他向一名26歲的Z世代年輕人提供人生建議，以下是這位以看空立場知名的投資人給年輕世代的10條建言。

從終身學習到拒絕賭博：貝瑞的10條人生建議

貝瑞提出了10項建議。第一項是「永遠不要停止運動或學習」，第二項則是「接受妥協，才能開始一段關係」，完整清單如下：
1、「永遠不要停止運動或學習。」
2、「接受妥協，才能開始建立關係。」
3、「發揮複利的力量。」
4、「絕不賭博。」
5、「生兒育女，做個好父母。」
6、「會飛或會漂浮的東西，就租不要買。」
7、「買得起多少房子，就只買一半。」
8、「在觀賞者眼中才有價值的藝術，並不昂貴。」
9、「對所有人與一切事物心懷感恩。」
10、「行善助人。」
貝瑞每個月都會將電子報收入的5%捐給一家慈善機構，這個月宣布的捐款對象為非營利醫療診所Siloam Health。他表示自己「很熟悉」這家機構，該診所為沒有保險的民眾、低收入在職者，以及不符合政府補助資格的新移民與難民提供醫療支持。
當有讀者詢問，「藝術的價值取決於觀賞者，價格可以很低」時，貝瑞解釋自己想表達的是，人生與物品不一定要昂貴，甚至不一定要花錢，才能從中獲得樂趣。

房子只買負擔得起的一半

貝瑞也建議：「買一間自己負擔得起的一半價格的房子。」這項建議有助於避免人們因沉重的房貸壓力，被迫留在自己不喜歡的工作崗位上。
這項建議雖然是針對尚未累積足夠存款或薪資、可能還無法踏入房市的年輕人，但對許多美國人而言，不論年齡大小，要負擔一整間房子，甚至只買得起半間，都已成為難以實現的目標。
美國全國房地產經紀人協會(NAR)最新公布的住房負擔能力指數顯示，9月指數為105.4，這是目前最新數據。指數達到100或以上，代表假設支付20%頭期款，收入中位數的家庭平均而言有足夠收入，能夠取得購買價格中位數住宅所需的房貸。
因此，9月的指數顯示，平均而言，一般家庭應有能力購屋，但實際情況會因購屋地點而有很大差異。例如，本月美國東北部與西部的住房負擔能力指數分別為91.5與77.9，均低於100。
此外，這項指數涵蓋所有家庭，不只首次購屋者。對首次購屋者而言，負擔能力更低，2026年平均指數僅為69.6。
paras_en: Fortune reported that Michael Burry, the real‑life inspiration for the film "The Big Short," disclosed in his Substack newsletter "Cassandra Unchained" that someone asked him to give life advice to a 26‑year‑old Gen‑Z individual; here are the ten pieces of advice this well‑known short‑seller offered to the younger generation.

From lifelong learning to refusing gambling: Burry’s ten life recommendations. He listed ten suggestions. The first is “Never stop exercising or learning,” and the second is “Accept compromise in order to start a relationship.” The full list follows:
1. “Never stop exercising or learning.”
2. “Accept compromise in order to start building a relationship.”
3. “Harness the power of compounding.”
4. “Never gamble.”
5. “Have children and be a good parent.”
6. “If something can fly or float, rent it instead of buying.”
7. “Buy only half the house you can afford.”
8. “Art that is valuable only in the eyes of the viewer does not have to be expensive.”
9. “Be grateful to everyone and everything.”
10. “Do good deeds and help others.”

Burry donates 5% of his newsletter revenue each month to a charitable organization; this month’s recipient is the nonprofit medical clinic Siloam Health. He said he is “very familiar” with the clinic, which provides medical support to uninsured people, low‑income workers, and new immigrants and refugees who do not qualify for government subsidies.

When a reader asked, “If the value of art depends on the viewer, the price can be low,” Burry explained that he meant life and possessions don’t have to be costly—or even require spending money—to bring enjoyment.

Buy only half the house you can afford. Burry also advises, “Buy a house that costs only half of what you can comfortably afford.” This suggestion helps people avoid being forced to stay in jobs they dislike because of heavy mortgage pressure.

Although this advice targets young people who have not yet accumulated enough savings or income to enter the housing market, for many Americans—regardless of age—affording an entire house, let alone even half of one, has become an unattainable goal.

The National Association of Realtors (NAR) recently released its latest housing affordability index, showing a September reading of 105.4, the most current data. An index of 100 or above indicates that, assuming a 20% down payment, a median‑income household on average has sufficient income to qualify for a mortgage on a median‑priced home.

Thus, the September index suggests that, on average, a typical household should be able to purchase a home, but actual affordability varies greatly by location. For example, this month the Northeast and the West of the United States posted affordability indices of 91.5 and 77.9 respectively, both below 100.
Moreover, the index covers all households, not just first‑time buyers. For first‑time homebuyers, affordability is even lower, with the 2026 average index projected at only 69.6.

items.title: 中國敦促美國停止擴大對中投資限制！警告衝擊雙邊經貿關係
items.title_en: China Urges the United States to Halt Expansion of Investment Restrictions on China, Warns of Impact on Bilateral Trade Relations
paras: 中國商務部週六（24日）敦促美國停止擴大美國投資中國的限制，並表示，美方針對敏感技術提出的新規，將破壞雙邊貿易關係。
根據《路透》報導，美國財政部週四（22日）提出修訂對外投資安全計畫的方案，將生物科技納入限制領域，並擴大對高效能運算及高超音速系統的管制範圍。
中國商務部在一份聲明中表示，該提案「歧視性地」擴大了針對中國的投資限制，並加碼了管制措施。
聲明指出，中方對此堅決反對，並保留採取未具體說明之反制措施的權利。
中國也警告，相關提案將損害中美雙邊經濟關係，且與兩國元首達成的共識背道而馳。兩國元首在過去6個月內已會晤兩次。
美國財政部則表示，相關措施並非僅針對中國，目的是阻止美國資金支持外國對手發展可能威脅美國國家安全的軍民兩用戰略技術。
此前，美國已針對涉及中國的半導體、量子技術和人工智慧（AI）領域的投資實施了限制。
paras_en: China's Ministry of Commerce on Saturday (the 24th) urged the United States to stop expanding restrictions on U.S. investment in China, stating that the new rules targeting sensitive technologies would damage bilateral trade relations.

According to Reuters, the U.S. Treasury Department on Thursday (the 22nd) proposed a revision to the Foreign Investment Risk Review (FIRR) plan that would add biotechnology to the list of restricted sectors and broaden controls over high‑performance computing and hypersonic systems.
In a statement, China's Ministry of Commerce said the proposal "discriminately" expands investment restrictions aimed at China and intensifies regulatory measures.
The statement noted that China firmly opposes the move and reserves the right to take unspecified retaliatory actions.
China also warned that the proposal would harm the U.S.–China economic relationship and run counter to the consensus reached by the two heads of state, who have met twice in the past six months.

The U.S. Treasury Department said the measures are not solely aimed at China but are intended to prevent American capital from supporting foreign rivals in developing dual‑use strategic technologies that could threaten U.S. national security.
Previously, the United States has already imposed restrictions on investments involving China in the semiconductor, quantum technology and artificial intelligence (AI) sectors.

paras: 連接器廠胡連(6279-TW)今(24)日公告，旗下義大利子公司Hu Lane Associate Europe S.r.l.已簽署股權買賣合約，將以688萬歐元(約新台幣2.5億元)收購義大利公司LA PUNTA S.R.L. 80%股權，跨足高端重機與頂級超跑供應鏈，交易預計於明年1月底完成。
胡連表示，本次收購主要為進行歐洲產業垂直與橫向整合，以滿足集團未來營運成長需求，透過收購不僅將跨足高端重機與頂級超跑供應鏈，還可分散單一區域市場風險、提升國際市場營收比重及前端研發與客訴回應速度，推動技術升級及多元產業延伸。
胡連表示，此次收購金額688萬歐元，其中企業價值為576萬歐元，另包含淨負債及營運資金112萬歐元，本次交易以現金為對價，資金來源為自有資金及銀行借款，收購完成後，將持續經營標的公司既有業務，並與現任經營團隊合作，整合集團資源，拓展國際市場及客戶基礎。
交易價格方面，胡連表示，公司委託國富浩華聯合會計師事務所評估，採用市場法中的可類比公司法及收益法中的現金流量折現法，分別賦予50%權重。市場法篩選7家全球公開發行的可類比公司，以本益比第一四分位數12.42倍作為評價依據；收益法則依標的公司未來預估現金流量進行折現。
經綜合評估，標的公司80%股權對應的企業價值合理區間為552.7萬至626.1萬歐元(未含淨負債及營運資金部位)，本次交易採用的企業價值576萬歐元落在上述合理區間內，因此，會計師認為交易價格尚屬合理。
paras_en: Connector maker Hu Lian (6279‑TW) announced today that its Italian subsidiary Hu Lane Associate Europe S.r.l. has signed a share purchase agreement to acquire an 80% stake in Italy’s LA PUNTA S.R.L. for €6.88 million (approximately NT$250 million). The deal, which will bring the company into the high‑end motorcycle and top‑tier supercar supply chain, is expected to close by the end of January next year.

Hu Lian said the acquisition is aimed at achieving vertical and horizontal integration of its European operations to meet future growth needs. By entering the high‑end motorcycle and supercar supply chain, the group can diversify regional market risk, increase the share of international revenue, and improve front‑end R&D and customer‑complaint response speed, thereby driving technology upgrades and diversification into new industries.

The purchase price of €6.88 million comprises an enterprise value of €5.76 million plus net debt and working capital of €1.12 million. The transaction will be paid in cash, funded by the company’s own resources and bank loans. After closing, Hu Lian will continue to operate the target’s existing business, cooperate with the current management team, integrate group resources, and expand its international market and customer base.

Regarding valuation, Hu Lian engaged Guo Fu Hao Hua United CPA Firm, which applied a 50/50 weighting of the market‑approach comparable‑company method and the income‑approach discounted cash‑flow method. The market approach screened seven publicly listed global peers and used the first‑quartile P/E multiple of 12.42× as the benchmark; the income approach discounted the target’s projected future cash flows.

Based on the combined assessment, the reasonable range for the enterprise value of the 80% stake is €5.527 million to €6.261 million (excluding net debt and working capital). The €5.76 million enterprise value used in this transaction falls within that range, so the accountants consider the purchase price to be reasonable.

paras_en: AI accelerator compute demand is exploding, and next‑generation chips require much larger substrate area and more layers, driving a sharp rise in demand for high‑end ABF substrates. With longer equipment lead times and much tougher processes, the high‑end supply‑demand gap is expected to widen through 2028. Global tech giants have already launched long‑term contracts and prepaid orders to lock in supply, signalling that pricing power has officially shifted from buyers to suppliers.
"Size and layer count surge non‑linearly, equivalent processing area climbs, testing process yield,"

In advanced packaging architectures, AI chips integrate more compute cores and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), causing the photomask size to expand from 1× in early generations to 3×, even over 9×. Substrate specifications have likewise jumped from the former 55 × 55 mm to 110 × 110 mm and to complex stacks of 26 layers or more. This drives a non‑linear explosion in equivalent processing area. Large area and high layer counts not only consume far more production capacity, they also magnify warpage caused by differences in coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) and make line‑up alignment far more difficult. Manufacturers that can achieve high‑volume production and yield control will command a premium for their technology.
"Glass and ceramic cores poised to take off, new materials force a technological shift,"

To overcome the physical warpage and thermal limits of traditional organic substrates at ultra‑large sizes, glass‑core substrates and ceramic intermediate layers have become the key breakthrough for next‑generation high‑end packaging. Although the new architectures initially face challenges in processing precision and yield maturity, major Taiwanese and Japanese firms have already begun early‑stage technology positioning. By introducing ultra‑low‑CTE materials, automated routing and design‑for‑manufacturability (DFM) rules, the supply chain is accelerating the transition from traditional organic cores to emerging inorganic materials. In the medium‑to‑long term this will unlock another wave of value‑creation from material upgrades in the substrate industry.

華航(2610-TW)則指出，今年旅展主打熱門航線最低76折起(均未稅)，其中，台北-布里斯本15957元起、台北-雪梨16188元起，台北-墨爾本、台北-奧克蘭同樣18000元有找，而台北-宿霧3354元起、台北-釜山5994元起。
華航將於10月25日在紐澳航線全面增班，雪梨增為每周7班、布里斯本增至每周6班、墨爾本增至每周5班。
paras_en: The largest travel fair in Taiwan—the 2026 ITF Taiwan International Travel Expo—will be held from November 6 to November 9. Many major tourism and airline companies have already launched online travel fairs. With a typhoon and a long weekend, a wave of travel buying surged this weekend, covering both airfare and themed tour packages.

Lion Travel (2731‑TW) said winter‑season travel orders are up 30% year‑over‑year, helped by stabilising ticket prices and a return of more than 60% of existing members. Travelers now focus more on the purpose of the trip than the destination, with over 70% of Japan‑bound tourists choosing hot springs, food and snow‑country as the three main winter themes.

Lion Travel further observed that short‑haul travelers prefer longer stays. Groups staying six days or more in Japan grew 40%, while Southeast‑Asia travelers shifted toward five‑star hotels and resort‑style vacations. Long‑haul demand rose as international connections and route networks recover and fares stabilise, with European orders up 60%; many booked six months ahead, especially for Northern‑Europe aurora tours and Sydney New Year’s trips.
Lion Travel is optimistic about winter and Chinese‑New‑Year demand, forecasting double‑digit year‑over‑year growth for this round of online travel‑fair sales.

EVA Air (2618‑TW) noted the online fair is underway, offering selected routes at 18% off (pre‑tax). Targeting short‑term flash travelers, it offers Taoyuan‑Hong Kong from NT$3,280, Taoyuan‑Seoul from NT$6,059, Taoyuan‑Okinawa from NT$6,640, and the most popular Japan route, Songshan‑Haneda from NT$11,305. For longer trips, Taoyuan‑Delhi starts at NT$13,940, Taoyuan‑Brisbane at NT$15,334, Taoyuan‑Vienna at NT$22,950, and Taoyuan‑San Francisco at NT$27,000 (tax included).
At the same time, EVA Air will create a lavish physical exhibition themed “Indian Palace” to celebrate the upcoming launch of the Taoyuan‑Delhi route on December 1.

China Airlines (2610‑TW) said the travel fair this year highlights popular routes at a minimum of 24% off (pre‑tax), including Taipei‑Brisbane from NT$15,957, Taipei‑Sydney from NT$16,188, and Taipei‑Melbourne and Taipei‑Auckland both at NT$18,000. Taipei‑Cebu starts at NT$3,354 and Taipei‑Busan at NT$5,994.
China Airlines will increase frequencies on its New Zealand‑Australia routes on October 25, raising Sydney to seven flights per week, Brisbane to six, and Melbourne to five.

items.title: 006208擬分割一拆八！12/18開受益人會議 入手一張只要3萬元
items.title_en: Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208) Plans 1‑for‑8 Split; Beneficiary Meeting on Dec 18, One Unit Costs Only NT$30,000
paras: 台股 ETF 人氣王之一－富邦台 50 ETF(006208-TW)終於走上分割之路，富邦投信將於12月18日以書面方式召開受益人會議，表決是否進行基金分割，初估分割倍數為8倍，藉此降低單位交易價格與投資門檻，屆時買進一張只要 3 萬元，讓小資族更容易入手。若議案順利通過，實際分割倍數將依會議通過當日的基金淨值計算。
富邦投信表示，006208追蹤臺灣50指數，持有台股市值最大的50家上市公司。該基金成立於2012年，初次發行價格為30元，隨台股長期走高，截至2026年10月6日，每單位淨值已達266.74元，市價約265.9元，均為發行價的近9倍，投資門檻也隨之提高，因此規劃透過分割，讓交易價格回到投資人較熟悉的區間，並維持市場流動性。
本次分割倍數並非固定8倍，而是依會議通過當日淨值，以回到30元以上的最大整數倍計算。例如，淨值介於240至269.99元，分割倍數為8倍；若介於270至299.99元，則為9倍。若以8倍分割為例，原持有1單位將調整為8單位，單位淨值則相應降低，基金總價值不會因分割而改變。
投資人可自11月26日起留意開會通知，並選擇書面投票，或透過「集保e手掌握」及各大證券下單App進入集保電子投票平台表決。電子投票期間為11月27日至12月15日，受益憑證過戶則自11月19日至12月18日停止辦理。分割案須有代表已發行受益權單位總數過半數的受益人出席，並經出席者表決權過半數同意，才能通過。
006208人氣與規模同步攀升，截至10月8日受益人數已達71.2萬人；基金規模也從2025年底約2897.8億元，增至今年10月6日的4963億元，今年增加逾2000億元、成長超過七成，距離5000億元大關僅一步之遙。值得注意的是，基金規模突破5000億元後，超過該門檻部分適用的經理費率將降至0.08%。若分割案順利過關，006208可望降低投資人進場門檻，進一步提升交易便利性。

paras_en: One of Taiwan's most popular stock ETFs, the Fubon Taiwan 50 ETF (006208‑TW), is finally moving toward a split. Fubon Asset Management will hold a written beneficiary meeting on December 18 to vote on whether to split the fund, initially estimating an 8‑for‑1 split to lower the unit price and entry threshold. After the split, a single unit could be bought for just NT$30,000, making it easier for retail investors. If the proposal passes, the exact split ratio will be calculated based on the fund's net asset value on the meeting day.

Fubon Asset Management says that 006208 tracks the Taiwan 50 Index, holding the 50 largest listed Taiwanese companies by market cap. The fund was launched in 2012 with an initial price of NT$30 per unit. As the Taiwan market has risen over the long term, the net asset value per unit reached NT$266.74 as of October 6, 2026, with a market price around NT$265.9—nearly nine times the issue price—raising the investment threshold. The split is intended to bring the trading price back to a range familiar to investors while preserving market liquidity.

The split ratio is not fixed at eight; it will be the largest integer multiple that brings the post‑split price back above NT$30, based on the NAV on the meeting day. For example, if the NAV is between NT$240 and NT$269.99, the split will be 8‑for‑1; if it is between NT$270 and NT$299.99, it will be 9‑for‑1. Using an 8‑for‑1 split as an example, one original unit would become eight units, with the unit NAV proportionally reduced, leaving the fund’s total value unchanged.

Investors can start watching for the meeting notice from November 26 and vote in writing, or use the “CDRC e‑Hand” platform and major brokerage apps to access the electronic voting system. The electronic voting period runs from November 27 to December 15, and the transfer of beneficiary certificates is suspended from November 19 to December 18. The split proposal requires attendance by beneficiaries representing more than half of the issued units and approval by a majority of the voting rights present.

The popularity and size of 006208 have both risen. As of October 8, the fund has 712,000 beneficiaries, and its assets under management grew from about NT$289.78 billion at the end of 2025 to NT$496.3 billion on October 6 this year—an increase of over NT$200 billion and more than 70% growth, putting it just shy of the NT$500 billion milestone. Notably, once assets exceed NT$500 billion, the management fee on the excess portion drops to 0.08%. If the split is approved, 006208 could lower entry barriers and further improve trading convenience.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉防詐業務需求強勁 GOGOLOOK股價周漲2成
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Strong Demand for Anti-Fraud Services, GOGOLOOK Shares Jump 20% This Week
paras: 信任科技服務商GOGOLOOK(6902-TW)受惠於海外市場擴張與多元產品線布局，9月營收續創單月新高紀錄，由於積極拓展防詐事業和金融科技，屬剛性需求，股價較未受大盤明顯波動的衝擊，本周股價大漲20%，周線連2紅，續戰歷史前高。
GOGOLOOK前三季合併營收3.36億元，年增25.7%，創單季新高，今年前三季營收9.48 億元，年增 26.9%，也創同期新高，GOGOLOOK樂觀看待，隨著營運規模突破關鍵門檻，獲利將隨營收規模同步放大，且下半年獲利將優於上半年。
GOGOLOOK主要發展消費者防詐、企業端防詐和金融科技服務等三大業務，其中，隨著海內外企業與政府機構積極提升資安防護能，GOGOLOOK防詐情資解決方案(ASI)在日本與合作夥伴推廣順利，將持續拓展更多海外市場。
GOGOLOOK 強調，持續投入 AI 防詐技術創新，主要鎖定東南亞7億人口市場，並將同步布局歐美地區，與國際組織、各國政府和大型企業合作。
而在金融科技服務方面，GOGOLOOK旗下JUJI 招財麻吉在風險控管、營收規模等營運表現持續優於內部預期，占整體營收比重可望上看30%。
在消費者防詐端，隨著詐騙手法日新月異，GOGOLOOK因應消費者的需求，旗下Whoscall持續迭代產品功能，近日開啟「自訂來電者名稱」功能，讓陌生來電不再陌生。
paras_en: Trust technology provider GOGOLOOK (6902-TW) benefited from overseas market expansion and a diversified product lineup, with September revenue setting a new monthly record. Driven by aggressive growth in its anti‑fraud business and fintech—both considered rigid demand—the stock was less affected by broader market volatility and surged 20% this week, posting two consecutive weekly gains and pushing toward a historic high.

GOGOLOOK reported combined revenue of NT$3.36 billion for the first three quarters, up 25.7% year‑over‑year and a new quarterly peak. Total revenue for the first three quarters reached NT$9.48 billion, up 26.9% YoY, also a record for the period. The company is optimistic that as its operating scale crosses key thresholds, profit will grow proportionally with revenue, and that second‑half earnings will surpass the first half.

GOGOLOOK’s core businesses are consumer anti‑fraud, enterprise anti‑fraud, and fintech services. With domestic and foreign enterprises and government agencies actively strengthening cybersecurity, GOGOLOOK’s anti‑fraud intelligence solution (ASI) is being successfully promoted in Japan with partners and will continue to expand into more overseas markets.

The company emphasizes ongoing investment in AI‑driven anti‑fraud technology, targeting the 700‑million‑person Southeast Asian market while simultaneously building a presence in Europe and the United States, collaborating with international organizations, governments and large corporations.

In fintech, GOGOLOOK’s subsidiary JUJI Zhaocai Maji has consistently outperformed internal expectations in risk control and revenue growth, and its contribution to total revenue could rise to about 30%.

On the consumer anti‑fraud front, as scam tactics evolve rapidly, GOGOLOOK responds to user needs through its Whoscall app, which continuously adds new features. Recently it launched a “custom caller name” function, making unknown calls recognizable.

items.title: 載板三雄誰最強？杜金龍點名ABF「這檔首選」獲利大調高！外資目標價曝光 還有這檔短多快閃操作！
paras: 台灣電路板產業年度盛事「TPCA 台灣電路板展」日前盛大開展，高階 AI 伺服器、高速運算對高階板材與高密度散熱的需求，再次成為市場焦點。在眾多零組件中，最吸金的莫過於沉寂已久的 ABF 載板族群。
隨著各大外資法人陸續調高評等，欣興(3037-TW)、南電(8046-TW)、景碩(3189-TW)這「載板三雄」全面轉強。股民們最關心的問題來了：如果資金有限只能買一檔，到底誰才是真正的真命天子？
台股老先覺杜金龍在《股民想知道》節目中給出肯定答案：「載板是我今年到處演講都強調、明年到後年整個 AI 裡最值得投資的類股！而這三檔裡面，我的首選絕對是 3037 的欣興！」
此外，針對展場上爆紅的輝達新材料概念股，杜金龍更揭露了主力「私募作價」的背後內幕，傳授一套精準的「短多快閃操作法」。

一、載板三雄大直球對決！杜金龍為什麼獨挑「欣興」？
在 ABF 載板三雄中，各有各的擁護者：
南電（8046）： 獲利能力最強，預估 EPS 高達 70 幾元，外資目標價甚至喊到 2,000 元以上。
景碩（3189）： 先前基期偏低，近期補漲力道猛烈，更有法人靠它繳出數倍的驚人報酬。
但杜金龍為何堅定首選欣興？他點出三大不可替代的關鍵：
大客戶全在欣興手上：欣興擁有極高的研發能量，技術遙遙領先，目前已成功布局最新 1.6T 高速光模組 PCB，通吃全球頂尖晶片龍頭訂單，產業護城河深厚。
走勢穩健「大漲小回」：相較於其他個股的暴起暴落，欣興的籌碼與多頭格局更具延續性，每波都是以大漲、小幅回檔整理的階梯式向上攻堅。
獲利預估大幅三級跳：杜金龍出示研究數據指出，法人原先預估欣興到 2028 年的 EPS 只有 50 元左右，但最新研究報告已全面大幅調升至「71 元以上」！

欣興目標價怎麼算？
杜金龍表示，最簡單的評價方式就是用「EPS × 本益比」：
71 元（EPS）× 20 倍本益比 ＝ 1,420 元
目前欣興股價已站穩千元之上，外資更是陸續調高目標價。杜金龍坦言，先前欣興因洗產地疑慮跌到 600 多元，後來拉回 940 元、1,000 元附近他都想買，「這檔股票真的是每次沒買它就噴上去！長線來看，只要月營收持續增加、法人持續調高 EPS，每一次拉回季線都是絕佳的存股上車點。」

二、鑽針消耗量激增！尖點（8021）有題材、做價差
除了載板本體，展場上另一個大亮點是「高階板材加工難度暴增」，鑽孔難度增加導致鑽針損耗率大增，鑽針大廠**尖點（8021）**因此受到關注。
尖點上半年 EPS 達 3.2 元，杜金龍以簡易年化估算，全年有望上看 6 元以上，較過去兩年大幅成長。但他提醒投資人：
(圖片來源:優分析產業數據庫)
尖點月 K 線的慣性是**「有利多就噴一段，隨後回檔盤整」**。
由於市場沒有長期的權威獲利模型做定錨，這檔股票適合在展覽題材點火、股價低檔轉折時**「快速來回做區間價差」**，不建議長線死抱。

三、短多快閃預警！輝達 PTFE 新材料爆紅，小心台郡「私募」陷阱！
除了載板，輝達日前在 OCP 全球峰會上展出 NVLink 交換器，宣布導入全新材料 PTFE（鐵氟龍），引爆台廠供應鏈包括**台郡（6269）、台虹（8039）**連續拉出數根漲停，連杜金龍的太太都忍不住掛漲停板追買。
但老先覺定睛一看，立刻看出其中的盤面玄機！
杜金龍指出，台郡雖然轉虧為盈（去年賠 6 元、今年賺 2 元、後年估 3 元），但這波噴出背後有一個不能說的祕密——台郡即將發行 3.2 億元、約佔 10% 的「私募現增案」！
「只要看到發行私募或可轉債，承銷券商的操作 SOP 大家一定要懂！」杜金龍以過去在大華證券承銷部龍頭的經驗直言：
定價前拉抬： 為了把私募或轉換價格拉高，主力與特定買盤會在定價前強勢拉抬股價。
定價後出貨： 一旦特定目標達成、定價宣布，這群特定的「護盤售後服務」就會獲利收案，股價往往應聲倒地（如先前的緯創定在 180 幾元、聯電定在 140 幾元，碰完就下殺）。

杜金龍親授「短多快閃退場訊號」：


觀察爆大量長黑日： 台郡連續漲停後已爆出歷史大量、出現開高走低的劇烈換手震盪。
逃命關鍵點： 只要盤中跌破「爆大量當天」的最低價，代表短線題材已透支、主力可能已經落跑，投資人務必當機立斷、先跑為上！ 至於台虹也是純題材發酵，同樣依循爆量低點作為嚴格的停利停損依據。

結語：核心重兵押欣興，短線題材快狠準！
總結 PCB 族群的操作全攻略，杜金龍建議投資人採取**「雙軌並行」**策略：
長線核心抱大波段： 重兵鎖定「欣興（3037）」，享受 EPS 上修至 71 元的長線大紅利，每次大盤拉回皆可逢低布局，抱到 2028 年 AI 巔峰期。
短線題材快進快出： 針對尖點、台郡、台虹等新題材股，認清其短多與私募作價的本質，有賺就跑，嚴守爆量低點停利，才能在題材狂潮中既賺到投機財，又全身而退！

items.title: 連老先覺也變心？過去堅持只存個股的杜金龍，這次竟然「首度買進這檔 ETF」！？
items.title_en: Has Even the Veteran Investor Du Jin‑Long Changed His Mind? The Long‑time Stock‑Pick‑Only Guru Finally Bought This ETF!
paras: 在台灣投資圈，只要提到「技術分析大師」與「基本面活字典」，資歷超過 30 年的股市老先覺——杜金龍絕對是首屈一指的代表。熟悉杜老師的股民都知道，他是標準的「個股基本面派」，滿手都是台積電、聯發科、欣興等龍頭權值股，過去極少將資金停泊在被動型 ETF 上。
然而，在這波台股從逼近 5 萬點高檔急殺 3,800 點、跌破季線 46,000 點的恐慌殺盤中，杜金龍卻在優分析《股民想知道》節目中罕見自曝：「這次跌下來我逢低開始慢慢買，而且最近我也去買了 ETF——我平常很少去買 ETF 的！」
究竟是什麼樣的市場巨變與新型產品，竟然能讓堅持只買績優個股的老先覺「打破原則、動心進場」？背後的選股邏輯與操盤玄機，值得所有投資人深入探究。

一、大師罕見打破原則！為什麼這次逢低「買 ETF」？
杜金龍透露，在加權指數逼近 5 萬點大關前，他早已居安思危，將持股比重從 7 月中旬抄底時的 95% 高檔，一路逢高調節降至 6 成。
而這波外資瘋狂提款 2 兆元、新台幣貶破 32 元大關，加權指數回測季線 46,000 點之際，他判定盤面已浮現短底，開始啟動逢低分批加碼，持股水位悄悄回升至 65%。除了加碼老朋友台積電與聯發科之外，最引人注目的，就是他首度將資金敲進了新一代的「主動式概念 ETF」！
「很多投資人看著高價股跌下來想撿，但口袋不夠深；或是看到大盤重挫心慌慌，不知道該挑哪一檔。」杜金龍直言，這批即將與正在發行的新型態 ETF，背後代表的是一股全新的法人定價勢力正在進場！

二、揭密法人選股密碼：什麼是「增肌減脂」AI 3.0？
能吸引杜金龍目光的，並非傳統只看市值排名的被動型指數，而是主打**「AI 3.0」選股哲學的主動型概念**。
杜金龍生動地形容，這類新形態基金的核心邏輯叫做**「增加肌肉，減少脂肪」**：
什麼是「脂肪」？傳統市值型 ETF 往往只看「市值前 50 大」，但很多老牌大公司股本雖大，獲利動能卻牛步停滯、甚至不賺錢，這些佔據權重卻無法貢獻報酬的標的，就是基金經理人眼中的「脂肪」，必須無情割除。
什麼是「肌肉」？未來 3 年 EPS 具備爆發性成長的「千金股」與「萬金股」！這類公司因為股本小，總市值不一定能擠進台股前 50 大，但毛利率驚人、獲利能力極度精壯（如緯穎、川湖等）。
「主動式 ETF 的買盤就是專挑這種高純度、高成長的『精壯肌肉股』納入核心持股！」杜金龍一語道破，這意味著被動挨打的高價電子股，即將迎來主動式基金源源不絕的抬轎買盤。

三、散戶的痛點：買不起「萬元股王」，靠 10 元銅板價跟著大戶吃肉！
談到千金股，杜金龍更幽默分享了自家的一段趣事。
「像我先前也是看好後市，跑去買了川湖(2059-TW)，結果我太太念我：『一張那麼貴，你買這個根本是虛榮心太重！』」
杜金龍笑著表示，連專業法人買一張上百萬、甚至幾百萬的高價股都會有所顧忌，一般散戶更是不可能動輒拿幾百萬去押注單一檔千金股。高價股雖然獲利爆發力強，但波動劇烈，一旦遇上如大立光、台光電、緯穎這種拉回三成的震盪波段，散戶的心臟往往承受不住。
「這就是為什麼這類 ETF 很有價值！」 杜金龍分析：
千金股平民化： 基金幫你把動輒數千元、甚至上萬元的頂級高價 AI 股打包在一起。
分散單一風險： 投資人只要花銅板價（10 元或 15 元），就能用極低門檻同時擁有一整籃全台灣獲利最強、EPS 最高的「萬金股候選人」，既享有 AI 頂級晶片與伺服器的長線暴利，又不用承擔個股腰斬的心理壓力。

四、大盤季線短底成形，選後「大作帳」一路賺到明年！
除了選對工具，進場時間點更是致勝關鍵。
杜金龍指出，外資雖然大倒 2 兆，但台幣匯市爆出單日百億巨量，已見短線滿足點；加上八大公股行庫連續買超 9～10 天，力守季線 46,000 點不破。
只要熬過兩個關鍵政治變數：
11 月 3 日「美國期中選舉」
11 月 28 日「台灣六都選舉」
「這兩個日期一過，利空出盡，台股就要開始做明年的行情了！」杜金龍強調，歷史統計顯示，大選後從 12 月到農曆春節、元宵節，台股平均都有 1,500 點至 1,800 點以上的跨年作帳行情。大盤在 46,000 點築底後，波段目標直指 53,000 點，長線更看好攻向 80,000 點。

結語：個股配 ETF，老先覺的最強資產配置法
連只做個股的老先覺杜金龍，都在這波拉回中將持股拉高至 65%，並首度配置兼具防禦與爆發力的主動式題材 ETF。
對於資金有限、又不想錯過 AI 萬金股大行情的投資朋友，不妨借鏡老先覺的「雙向戰法」：核心資金逢低分批存「三台一發」（台積電、聯發科等優質龍頭），其餘部位透過「增肌減脂」的高純度 AI ETF 輕鬆卡位千金股！ 把握選前震盪的最後黃金買點，一起迎接年底作帳大紅包！

paras_en: In Taiwan’s investment circles, whenever “technical‑analysis master” and “fundamental‑analysis dictionary” are mentioned, the 30‑plus‑year‑veteran stock‑market sage Du Jin‑Long is the top example. Investors familiar with Du know he is a classic “stock‑fundamentals type,” holding heavyweight names like TSMC, MediaTek and Unimicron, and has historically kept almost all his capital in individual stocks rather than passive ETFs.

However, during the recent panic sell‑off that saw the Taiwan index plunge from near the 50,000‑point high down to 38,000 points and break below the 46,000‑point seasonal line, Du Jin‑Long made a rare self‑disclosure on the You‑Analysis “Investors Want to Know” program: “This time the market fell, I started buying on the dips, and I even bought an ETF recently—I rarely buy ETFs!”

What kind of market upheaval and new product could make a staunch individual‑stock investor like the veteran break his own rule and jump in? The stock‑selection logic and trading secrets behind it are worth a deep dive for every investor.

1. The master breaks his rule! Why is he now buying ETFs on the dip? Du revealed that before the index approached the 50,000‑point milestone, he had already been cautious, trimming his equity exposure from a peak of 95% when he bottom‑filled in mid‑July down to 60% as the market rose.

During the wave of foreign investors pulling out NT$2 trillion, the New Taiwan dollar slipping past NT$32, and the index testing the 46,000‑point seasonal line, he judged that a short‑term bottom was forming and began a phased dip‑buy, quietly raising his equity level to 65%. In addition to adding more TSMC and MediaTek, the most eye‑catching move was his first allocation to a new‑generation “active‑concept ETF.”

“Many investors see high‑price stocks falling and want to pick them up, but they don’t have deep enough pockets; others see the market crashing and feel nervous, not knowing which stock to choose,” Du said. He added that the soon‑to‑be‑issued new‑type ETFs represent a brand‑new institutional‑pricing force entering the market!

2. Unveiling the institutional stock‑picking code: What is “muscle‑gain, fat‑loss” AI 3.0? What attracted Du’s attention was not a traditional market‑cap‑weighted passive index, but an active‑concept fund that champions an “AI 3.0” stock‑selection philosophy.
Du vividly described the core logic of these new‑style funds as “adding muscle, shedding fat.”

What is “fat”? Traditional market‑cap ETFs usually track the top 50 companies by market value, but many large‑cap firms have stagnant or even negative earnings momentum. Those heavyweight holdings that contribute little or no return are the “fat” that fund managers must cut away.

What is “muscle”? “Muscle” refers to “thousand‑dollar stocks” and “ten‑thousand‑dollar stocks” that are expected to explode in EPS over the next three years. These companies may be too small to rank in Taiwan’s top‑50 by market cap, yet they boast extraordinary gross margins and razor‑sharp profitability (e.g., Wi‑Ying, Chuan‑Lake, etc.).

“Active‑ETF buying is all about targeting these high‑purity, high‑growth ‘lean‑muscle’ stocks for core holdings!” Du summed up, meaning that the high‑price electronic stocks that have been battered by passive flows are about to receive a steady stream of buying from active funds.
3. Retail pain points: Can’t afford “ten‑thousand‑dollar stock kings,” so follow the big players at NT$10‑level! When talking about thousand‑dollar stocks, Du shared a humorous personal anecdote.
“I once was bullish on the outlook and bought Chuan‑Lake (2059‑TW). My wife scolded me: ‘That share is so expensive; you’re just being vain!’”

Du laughed that even professional institutions hesitate to buy a single share costing hundreds of thousands or millions, let alone ordinary retail investors who cannot risk a few hundred thousand on one “thousand‑dollar” stock. High‑price stocks may have strong profit bursts, but they are volatile; when they pull back 30% like Largan Precision, Taiwan‑Optoelectronics or Wi‑Ying, retail investors often can’t stomach the swing.
“That’s why these ETFs are so valuable,” Du explained:
• Democratizing thousand‑dollar stocks: The fund bundles top‑tier, high‑price AI stocks that would otherwise cost thousands or tens of thousands of dollars into one package.

• Diversifying single‑stock risk: Investors can spend a copper‑price (NT$10 or NT$15) to own a basket of Taiwan’s strongest, highest‑EPS “ten‑thousand‑dollar” candidates, gaining exposure to elite AI chips and servers without the psychological strain of a single stock crash.
4. A short‑term bottom is forming on the seasonal line; after the pick, “big accounting” can run through next year! Besides picking the right tool, timing the entry is the decisive factor.

Du noted that although foreign investors withdrew NT$2 trillion, the forex market saw a single‑day surge of NT$100 billion, indicating short‑term relief; plus the eight major state‑owned banks have been net buyers for 9‑10 consecutive days, helping to hold the 46,000‑point seasonal line.
He said the market only needs to get through two key political variables:
• November 3 – U.S. midterm elections
• November 28 – Taiwan’s six‑city mayoral elections

“Once those dates pass, the negative news will be exhausted and the Taiwan market will start the next year’s rally,” Du emphasized. Historical data shows that after elections, from December through the Lunar New Year and Lantern Festival, the index typically gains 1,500‑1,800 points. After bottoming at 46,000, the next wave targets 53,000, with a long‑term view toward 80,000 points.

Conclusion: Pairing individual stocks with ETFs – the veteran’s strongest asset‑allocation method. Even the stock‑only guru Du Jin‑Long lifted his equity exposure to 65% during this pull‑back and, for the first time, added an active‑theme ETF that offers both defense and explosive upside.

For investors with limited capital who don’t want to miss the AI “ten‑thousand‑dollar” rally, consider Du’s “dual‑strategy”: core capital buys “three‑T’s in one” (TSMC, MediaTek and other quality leaders) on dips, while the remaining portion captures high‑purity AI ETFs using the “muscle‑gain, fat‑loss” approach to lock in thousand‑dollar stocks. Seize the final golden entry point in the pre‑rally swing and welcome the year‑end accounting bonanza!
